notes: Mid-market B2B SaaS building a customer success / knowledge search product. Primary evaluation track: start on Hosted API for fast iteration (embeddings + nearest-neighbor), then migrate to Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost controls once POC validates latency and batch throughput. Team emphasized heavy nightly batch embedding jobs for 10M+ docs, plus per-request real-time scoring for search reranking. Keen on prefix caching, bulk ingestion paths, and efficient cold-start for embeddings. Requests: clear guidance on vector DB pairing options and recommended ingest pipeline (chunking, dedup, hashing). Wants sample cost model comparing hosted per-embed vs Dedicated reserved capacity for steady-state workloads.
requirements_summary: High-volume embeddings pipeline (daily incremental + nightly full reindex), online semantic search with <60ms 95th percentile for vector lookup+rerank at 50 qps peak, integration with managed vector DB (Pinecone/Weaviate/Milvus), SSO and audit logging, EU data residency for specific customers. Cost sensitive; looking to reduce per-embed cost via batching/quantization and consider Dedicated commit if ROI >30% vs hosted.
technical_preferences: Prefer open model variants for embeddings (open-source 8-bit quantized), fallback to Redwood-verified models for QA. Wants ability to route low-latency traffic to Dedicated in NA region and fall back to hosted EU region for residency-bound requests.
